meta.name: react-useeffect
meta.description: React useEffect best practices from official docs. Use when writing/reviewing useEffect, useState for derived values, data fetching, or state synchronization. Teaches when NOT to use Effect and better alternatives.

copy.tagline: 按官方最佳实践编写和审查 React useEffect
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在写或审查 React 组件的副作用逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Write and review React useEffect with official best practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing or reviewing side effects in React components

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 React 官方文档的最佳实践，指导你何时不该用 useEffect，并提供更好的替代方案。
howto.when: 当你编写或审查 React 代码，涉及 useEffect、useState 派生值、数据获取或状态同步时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个 useEffect 是否必要，有没有更好的写法？
say.note: Claude 会分析你的 Effect 并给出改进建议。

say.text: 如何根据 props 计算派生状态，而不使用 Effect？
say.note: Claude 会解释在渲染时直接计算的方法。

say.text: 这个数据获取的 Effect 缺少清理函数，帮我加上。
say.note: Claude 会添加清理函数以避免内存泄漏。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows React official docs best practices, guiding when NOT to use useEffect and providing better alternatives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when writing or reviewing React code involving useEffect, useState for derived values, data fetching, or state synchronization.

say_en.text: Check if this useEffect is necessary and suggest a better approach.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze your Effect and give improvement suggestions.

say_en.text: How to compute derived state from props without using Effect?
say_en.note: Claude will explain computing during render.

say_en.text: This data-fetching Effect lacks cleanup, please add it.
say_en.note: Claude will add cleanup to prevent memory leaks.
